items.question: What are the defining attributes of the sixth cakra in this sequence?
premises: The sixth cakra is introduced as the next in sequence.
It is characterized as royal or sovereign.
It is described as having eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal eight-petaled wheel endowed with a pericarp.
uncertainties: The specific symbolic meaning of rājānam as an epithet is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is the royal one, having eight petals and a pericarp.
